title: 第064章 十丈法相的修炼条件第63章 天圣文明的秘密
slug: 全民修仙之系统上交囯家
content_zh:
灰尘从破碎的断口处扬起，在灵灯的光里弥漫成一团淡淡的灰雾。张山风把拳头收回来，站在那片破碎的石块中间，灰尘绕着他的脚踝缓缓升腾。张德华站在三步之外，隔着那层灰尘看着他。没有说话。然后他转身朝门口走去。走到门口的时候，他停下来，侧过身，没有回头："今晚食堂加餐。你师娘让炊事班蒸了星果糕。"他走了出去。
张山风站在破碎的靶石中间，灰尘正在慢慢落定。他低头看着自己的右拳。整个上国基地里，灵能核心的监测器上跳了一下。那一下很短——只是一瞬间的峰值波动，然后回落正常。但监测室里的值班员还是看了一眼，嘀咕了一声："刚才谁砸了一下？"窗外的赤红星尘，在六月初的光线里缓缓流动。基地食堂的烟囱正在冒出一缕极细的白烟。今天晚上，有星果糕。
指挥中心的全息星图前，张德华已经站了大约两刻钟。
星图投射在半空中的影像正在缓慢旋转，赤火星域、天圣边境、母星方向的三条灵脉轨迹线在光幕上交织，像一张被拉开的蛛网。
他的右手按在操作台边缘，指尖正对着天圣母星的位置。那个位置在星图上标注着"能源枯竭·不可逆"五个红色的字——伏羲在三天前加上的标注。
他没有在看那颗星。他在看星图边缘，一条几乎看不见的虚线。那条线从赤火星域一直延伸到天圣母星背面一个未标注的区域，然后用一个极小的灰色光点收尾。灰色光点的旁边没有文字说明，只有一个编号：零七号禁地。天圣大帝的私人修炼场。
"系统。"他开口了。声音不高，带着一种像在确认什么事之前特有的那种平，"十丈法相的修炼条件，完整列一次。"
全息星图的光暗了一下，然后重新亮起来。一行文字从光幕中心浮现出来，悬浮在星图上方，笔画清晰："十丈法相修炼前置条件：一、法相结晶·核心（未获取）。二、时间加速环境（已具备，需外部连续三十日以上）。三、基础法相修为达到五十丈以上（已达标）。备注：法相结晶位置已由量子探测仪在二次扫描中初步锁定。"
那条灰色虚线在地图上闪了一下，然后变成亮金色，从张德华指尖的位置延伸向那颗未标注的光点。光点旁边多了一行小字："天圣文明禁地·零七号——坐标已确认。"
张德华看着那颗光点，手指从操作台上收回来，交叠在身前。"那颗禁地的防御等级？"
"初步探测显示：外围三层灵能屏障，内核一层禁制封印。禁制封印的强度相当于大乘五重全力一击。"伏羲的声音从扬声器里传出来，"按照当前情报，那颗禁地的屏障仍在正常运行状态。天圣大帝尚未对禁地进行过任何撤离或封存操作。"
"他还没动它。"
"正确。法相结晶应该是天圣文明历代传承之物，非紧急情况下不会动用。"
张德华把右手从操作台上收回来，站直了。他转身面朝窗口，看着窗外那片正在缓慢流转的赤红星尘。星尘在他面前铺展成一片暗红色的厚毯，颗粒在恒星的光照下反射出细碎的金色光点，像一层正在流动的沙。他没有立刻说话。窗口的玻璃映出他自己的倒影——模糊的轮廓，肩甲上的星徽在倒影中化作三枚暗色的圆斑。
"那就再打一次天圣。"他说。然后他停顿了大约三息。那三息里，只有灵能核心的嗡鸣声从地板下方传上来，闷闷的，像远处正在翻涌的潮水。"这次，直接谈判。"
伏羲的终端蓝光稳定地亮着，没有任何波动。"需要更新远征计划吗？"
"更新。目标从歼灭改为接触。舰队规模不变，但交战权限下调两级。非自卫不开火。把那个被审过的俘虏带来，他有家人在天圣母星上。"张德华转过身来，目光从窗外收回来落在伏羲的终端上，"让他带一句话回去给天圣大帝。"
"什么话？"
"上国可以修复你的母星。用一颗法相结晶来换。"
伏羲沉默了一息。然后它的声音重新响起来，比刚才低了一点，像是正在运算什么更复杂的路径："天圣大帝会怀疑我们的诚意。"

"他会。"
"那为什么还要去？"
张德华的嘴角动了一下。那个弧度很小，几乎不像在笑，更像是一个人正在确认自己已经决定了的事。"因为他左胸的旧伤还没好。他打不过现在的我。打不过的时候，人就会开始听别人说话。"他走到门口的时候忽然停下来，没有回头，只侧了侧头，"还有，把何天紫叫到指挥中心来。我要跟她核对禁地的阵法结构。她要突破天机令了，在那之前，她得先知道那颗禁地里的东西值不值得去一趟。"
何天紫到指挥中心的时候，是半刻钟之后。她进门的时候手里端着一杯灵茶，杯沿还冒着极淡的白气。茶水的热度传到她掌心里，把指尖捂成了暖色。她没有坐下，靠在门边的台面边缘，喝了一口茶，然后看着全息星图上那颗正在闪烁的金色光点。
"天圣禁地？"
"嗯。法相结晶在那儿。"
何天紫把茶杯放下，走前了两步，站在星图面前。她的目光扫过那条金色虚线的全程走向——从赤火星域到天圣母星背面，穿过三层星尘稀疏区，绕过两个小型灵能漩涡，在禁地外围的屏障标记处停了一下。"这颗禁地我搜过天机令的记录，"她说，"天圣立国时就存在的遗迹。法相结晶应该是他们的初代国主留下的。"
"你搜过？"
"在上次审俘虏的时候。"何天紫偏过头来看他，"我以为你会打。"
张德华也看着她。"改了。"
"改得好。"何天紫把目光收回去，重新落在星图上。她抬起手指，指尖在禁地外围那三层屏障标记上依次点了一下，"第一层是灵能感应网。第二层是冲击反制阵。第三层，也是最麻烦的一层——天圣锁，一种血脉封禁术。非天圣皇室血脉触碰，会触发整颗禁地的自毁程序。"
张德华的眉头动了一下，松开了。"所以需要天圣大帝亲自开门。"
"对。"何天紫把指尖收回来，在袖口上蹭了蹭，"他现在还没动禁地，说明他还没想到法相结晶可以换母星的命。但他三个月后会想起来的。六个月后大概就会用那颗结晶去别的地方换资源了。"她的声音不高，但每个字都像钉子，"我们的窗口期，最多三个月。"
张德华没有接话。他看着那颗金色光点，看了很久。然后他开口了："三个月。够何天紫突破天机令的进阶吗？"
何天紫的手指顿了一下——她把茶杯端起来的动作停在了半空，杯沿离嘴唇还剩一寸。她低头看茶水的表面，那一层极薄的白气正在散去，露出底下浅碧色的茶汤。然后她把茶杯放下，没有喝。
"够。"她说，"但我要回一趟天机阁主星。进阶天机令需要本殿禁地的灵脉加持，在外面完成不了。"
"多久？"
"七天。"
content_en:
Dust rose up from the broken parts, forming a faint gray mist in the light of the spiritual lamp. Zhang Shanfeng retracted his fist and stood among the broken stones, dust slowly rising around his ankles. Zhang Dehua stood three steps away, looking at him through the layer of dust. No words were spoken. Then he turned and walked toward the door. When he reached the door, he stopped, turned sideways, and did not look back: "There will be extra food in the cafeteria tonight. Your wife asked the cooking team to steam star fruit cake." He walked out.
Zhang Shanfeng stood among the broken target rocks, and the dust was slowly settling. He looked down at his right fist. Throughout the Shangguo base, the monitors of the psychic core jumped. It was a short one - just a momentary spike before falling back to normal. But the person on duty in the monitoring room still took a look and muttered: "Who hit it just now?" The red stardust outside the window slowly flowed in the light of early June. A very thin plume of white smoke was emitting from the chimney of the base canteen. Tonight, there is star fruit cake.
Zhang Dehua had been standing in front of the holographic star map in the command center for about two quarters of an hour.
The image of the star map projected in mid-air is slowly rotating, and the three spiritual vein trajectories in the direction of the red Mars domain, the Tiansheng border, and the mother star are intertwined on the light screen, like a stretched spider web.
His right hand was pressed on the edge of the console, with his fingertips facing the position of the Virgin Mary. That location was marked with five red words "Energy Exhaustion·Irreversible" on the star map - a mark added by Fuxi three days ago.
He wasn't looking at the star. He was looking at the edge of the star map, an almost invisible dotted line. The line stretches from the Red Mars domain to an unlabeled area on the backside of Celestial Mother, and ends with a tiny gray point of light. There is no text description next to the gray light spot, only a number: Forbidden Land No. 07. The private training ground of Emperor Tiansheng.
"System." He started. The voice was not high, with a calmness that is unique to confirming something, "The cultivation conditions of Shizhang Dharma are listed in full."
The light of the holographic star map dimmed for a moment, then lit up again. A line of text emerged from the center of the light screen, suspended above the star map, with clear strokes: "Prerequisites for the cultivation of the Dharma Phase: 1. Dharma Phase Crystal·Core (not obtained). 2. Time acceleration environment (already available, requires more than 30 consecutive days externally). 3. The basic Dharma Phase Cultivation reaches more than fifty feet (reached the standard). Note: The position of the Dharma Phase Crystal has been initially locked by the quantum detector in the second scan."
The gray dotted line flashed on the map for a moment, then turned into bright gold, extending from Zhang Dehua's fingertips to the unlabeled light spot. There is a line of small words next to the light spot: "Tian Sheng Civilization Forbidden Land No. 07 - Coordinates confirmed."
Zhang Dehua looked at the light spot, withdrew his fingers from the operating table and folded them in front of him. "The defense level of that forbidden land?"
"Preliminary detection shows: three layers of psychic barriers on the periphery and one layer of prohibition seal on the core. The strength of the prohibition seal is equivalent to a full-strength strike of the fifth level of Mahayana." Fuxi's voice came from the loudspeaker, "According to the current information, the barrier of the forbidden land is still in normal operation. Emperor Tiansheng has not conducted any evacuation or sealing operation on the forbidden land."
"He hasn't touched it yet."
"Correct. The Dharma Crystal should be something passed down from generation to generation by the Heavenly Saint Civilization and will not be used except in emergencies."
Zhang Dehua took his right hand back from the operating table and stood up straight. He turned to face the window and looked at the slowly flowing red stardust outside the window. The stardust spread out in front of him into a thick dark red blanket, and the particles reflected fine golden light spots under the light of the star, like a layer of flowing sand. He didn't speak immediately. The glass of the window reflected his own reflection - a blurred outline, and the star emblem on the shoulder armor turned into three dark round spots in the reflection.
"Then beat Tiansheng again." He said. Then he paused for about three breaths. During those three breaths, only the buzzing sound of the psychic core came up from under the floor, muffled, like the surging tide in the distance. "This time, direct negotiations."
The blue light of Fuxi's terminal lit up steadily without any fluctuations. "Need to update the expedition plan?"
"Update. The target is changed from annihilation to contact. The size of the fleet remains unchanged, but the engagement authority is lowered by two levels. Do not fire unless in self-defense. Bring the prisoner who has been interrogated. He has family members on the Heavenly Mother Star." Zhang Dehua turned around and looked back from the window to focus on Fuxi's terminal. "Ask him to bring a message back to Emperor Tiansheng."
"What words?"
"Shangguo can repair your home planet. Use a dharma crystal in exchange."
Fuxi was silent for a breath. Then its voice sounded again, a little lower than before, as if it was calculating a more complicated path: "The Heavenly Saint Emperor will doubt our sincerity."
"He will."
"Then why go?"
The corners of Zhang Dehua's mouth moved. The arc was very small, almost like a smile, more like a person confirming what he had already decided. "Because the old injury on his left chest hasn't healed yet. He can't beat me now. When you can't beat me, you will start to listen to what others say." He suddenly stopped when he walked to the door and did not look back. He only turned his head sideways. "Also, call He Tianzi to the command center. I want to check the formation structure of the forbidden area with her. She is going to break through the Tianji Order. Before that, she must first know whether the things in the forbidden area are worth a trip."
When He Tianzi arrived at the command center, it was half a quarter of an hour later. When she came in, she was holding a cup of spiritual tea in her hand, with a very faint white gas still rising from the rim of the cup. The heat of the tea spread to her palms, turning her fingertips into a warm color. She did not sit down, but leaned on the edge of the countertop by the door, took a sip of tea, and then looked at the flickering golden dot on the holographic star map.
"The Holy Forbidden Land?"
"Yeah. The Dharma crystallization is there."
He Tianzi put down the teacup, took two steps forward, and stood in front of the star map. Her eyes scanned the entire path of the golden dotted line - from the Red Mars domain to the back of the Heavenly Mother Star, passing through three layers of sparse stardust, bypassing two small psychic vortices, and stopped at the barrier mark outside the forbidden area. "I have searched the records of the Tianji Order in this forbidden place," she said. "It is a relic that existed when the Tiansheng Kingdom was founded. The Dharma Crystal should be left by their first king."
"Have you searched?"
"During the last interrogation of prisoners." He Tianzi turned to look at him, "I thought you knew how to fight."
Zhang Dehua also looked at her. "Changed."
"Good change." He Tianzi looked away and fell on the star map again. She raised her finger and clicked her fingertips on the three-layer barrier marks on the outside of the forbidden area. "The first layer is the psychic induction network. The second layer is the impact counterattack array. The third layer is also the most troublesome layer - the Heavenly Saint Lock, a bloodline sealing technique. Touching the bloodline of non-Heavenly Saint royal family will trigger the self-destruction program of the entire forbidden area."
Zhang Dehua's brows moved and relaxed. "So the Emperor Tiansheng needs to open the door himself."
"Yes." He Tianzi retracted his fingertips and rubbed them on his sleeves. "He hasn't touched the forbidden area yet, which means he hasn't thought that the Dharma Crystal can change the life of the home planet. But he will think about it in three months. After six months, he will probably use the crystal to exchange resources elsewhere." Her voice was low, but every word was like a nail. "Our window period is three months at most."
Zhang Dehua did not answer the call. He looked at the golden spot of light for a long time. Then he spoke: "Three months. Is it enough for He Tianzi to break through the Tianji Order?"
He Tianzi's fingers paused - she stopped lifting the tea cup in mid-air, with the rim still an inch away from her lips. She lowered her head to look at the surface of the tea. The extremely thin layer of white air was dissipating, revealing the bottom layer.Drink light blue tea soup. Then she put the tea cup down without drinking.
"Enough." She said, "But I have to go back to the main star of Tianji Pavilion. The advanced Tianji Order requires the blessing of the spiritual veins in the forbidden area of ​​this palace, and it cannot be completed outside."
"How long?"
"Seven days."
